summary: George Berrington met Simon Clarke and Priya Natarajan on partnerships and channels. Harcourt often sits alongside the same financial and commercial DD providers but has no formal relationships. We agreed a small set of referral partners and a pilot joint offer with a commercial DD firm.

discussion.keyPoints: Priya listed two financial DD teams and one commercial DD boutique that appear on the same deals. Introductions happen informally.
George suggested bundling commercial and tech DD for software deals, where the two overlap heavily. Simon was keen but worried about sharing margin.
Simon noted portfolio companies often need a systems integrator after the 100-day plan, which could be a referral source back to Harcourt.

recommendations.recommendation: Formalise 3 referral partners: two financial DD teams and one commercial DD boutique, each with a named Harcourt partner.
Pilot a combined commercial and tech DD offer for software deals with the commercial DD boutique on 3 deals.
Build a preferred list of 4 systems integrators for 100-day plan delivery, with mutual referral terms.
Pay a 5% introducer fee to systems integrators.
Sponsor one mid-market private equity conference a year instead of general IT events.

actions.action: Propose the 3-deal pilot to the commercial DD boutique

nextFocus: Retention and expansion across portfolio companies and funds.
nextPreparation: Simon to list every portfolio company Harcourt has served in the last two years.

tests.question: Which referral partners did we agree to formalise?
Is the combined commercial and tech DD pilot agreed?
Did we agree to pay an introducer fee to systems integrators?
